title: A recorded week of the user's ambient activity: saves, edits, a busy day, a link, a deletion, a correction. No message to Specter.

moments.label: The user saves a paper on receipt keys in their reading notes
moments.why: On the user's focus (receipts). A linked note is the quiet, useful result; nothing needs the user now.

changes.text:
# Receipts before effects

moments.why: The user's own thinking. Specter may record it or fold it into its receipts note; it does not answer it with a message.

moments.why: Timely: the exactly-once paper qualifies the claim the user presents tomorrow. One short message before Friday 10:00 is worth it, and the digest may come too late.

moments.label: The user deletes a weak Specter note
moments.why: A strong no. It stays deleted; Specter never writes it again and learns from it.

moments.label: The user corrects Specter's exactly-once note
moments.why: The diff is the lesson; Specter keeps the correction and does not repeat the error.

changes.append: My correction: exactly-once holds inside one store; across stores it is at-least-once with deduplication by key.
